**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A UI pass that changes a TUI view has no ready way to render it. `AGENTS.md` (Project Commands, lines 102-113) and `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:64-68` tell each role to write its own `render_overlay_test.go` and `overlay.json` by hand. In run ork-20261125-015357-ca10 (item S251) the ui role wrote both by hand to render 6 views at 5 sizes. The CLI side already has a ready harness: `-renders DIR` and `-render-fixture NAME[,NAME...]` in `internal/cli/render_test.go:26-31`, named in the UI brief (`internal/engine/brief.go:231-233`).

Owner decision adj 644 (supersedes adj 507, Jon, session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27): `internal/tui` gets test flags that mirror the CLI's. They write the default views at 80x24 and 120x40 plus an ASCII render as `.txt` files. A second mode prints each fixture's text to stdout (merged from S642, adj 631). The overlay recipe in `AGENTS.md` and `ui.md` is replaced. S641 is also in scope: a render fixture's `next:` hint must not differ from what the daemon's `pausedNext` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:3098`) gives for that pause. The round-1 wait-block fixture showed `next: ork retry r1` on a question pause.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 644 (supersedes adj 507: TUI render flags plus a print mode), adj 649 (NAME-80x24.txt, NAME-120x40.txt, NAME-ascii.txt; -render-print), adj 650 (five default fixtures: overview, roadmap, launch-confirm, approval-card, approval-render) and adj 651 (fixtures derive next: from an exported daemon.PausedNext; -render-size WxH writes NAME-WxH.txt).

## Failing tests

The names in this section follow the recommended options of Owner needed 1 to 5. ork replaces them if the owner picks others.

- TestRenderTUIViewsWritesFiles (`internal/tui/render_views_test.go`): runs the test binary as a subprocess, as `TestRenderCLIViewsWritesFiles` does (`internal/cli/render_test.go:568`), with `-test.run=^TestRenderTUIViews$`. It asserts:
  - `flag.Lookup` finds `renders`, `render-fixture`, `render-print` and `render-size`.
  - With no flag the directory stays empty.
  - `-renders DIR` writes the default fixtures, three files each: `NAME-80x24.txt`, `NAME-120x40.txt` and `NAME-ascii.txt`.
  - `-render-fixture a,b` writes only those two fixtures' files.
  - An unknown name fails with `no render fixture "nope"`.
  - `-render-fixture` without `-renders` writes nothing.
  - Each fixture alone writes its three files.
  - `-render-size 100x30,60x20` writes `NAME-100x30.txt` and `NAME-60x20.txt` for each selected fixture, in addition to the three default files (adj 651).
  - Every file is non-empty and holds no ESC byte.
- TestRenderTUIViewsFitTheirSize (`internal/tui/render_views_test.go`): for each fixture, the 80x24 file has at most 24 rows and no row wider than 80 runes, and the 120x40 file has at most 40 rows and no row wider than 120 runes. The ASCII file has no `│` or `─`.
- TestRenderTUIViewsPrintsText (`internal/tui/render_views_test.go`): `-render-print -render-fixture NAME -v` prints a header line naming the fixture and size, then the plain view text, to stdout for each of the three renders, and for each `-render-size` size. With no `-renders` it writes no file. With neither flag it prints nothing.
- TestRenderTUIFixtureDocsListEveryFixture (`internal/tui/render_views_test.go`): `docs/guide.md` and `docs/design.md` each name every TUI fixture by its exact name, in backticks, in their TUI `-render-fixture` list.
- TestUIPassBriefNamesTheTUIRenderCommand (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): the UI brief has a `## TUI renders` section between `## CLI text renders` and `## Test run patterns`. The section holds `go test ./internal/tui -run TestRenderTUIViews -renders DIR` with the temp directory as DIR, names `-render-fixture NAME[,NAME...]`, `-render-print`, `-render-size WxH[,WxH...]` and every TUI fixture, and holds no `-overlay`. The implementer brief has no `## TUI renders` section.
- TestUIPromptHasNoOverlayRecipe (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md` has no `-overlay` and no `render_overlay_test.go`. It points the pass to the brief's TUI render command.
- TestRenderWaitPausesUsePausedNext (`internal/cli/render_test.go`): each paused reply the wait fixtures build has a `Next` equal to what `daemon.PausedNext` gives for a record with that pending kind. A question pause is `ork answer r1 TEXT`, never `ork retry r1`.

## Implement

1. In `internal/tui/render_views_test.go` (new, SPDX header) add the flags `renders` (directory), `renderFixture` (`render-fixture`, comma-separated names) and `renderPrint` (`render-print`, bool), and the type `renderView{name string; general bool; build func(t *testing.T) *Model}`. `renderViews()` lists the fixtures (see Owner needed 3). Each builder reuses the existing harnesses and returns the model ready to draw.
2. In the same file add `renderViewTexts(m *Model) (files map[string]string)`. It calls `m.Update(tea.WindowSizeMsg{...})` and `plainView(m)` at 80x24 and 120x40. It then sets `m.cfg.Theme, m.cfg.ASCII = NewTheme(true), true` and renders 80x24 again for the ASCII file. Keys are `NAME-80x24`, `NAME-120x40` and `NAME-ascii`.
3. Add `TestRenderTUIViews`. With no `-renders` and no `-render-print` it returns and writes nothing. Otherwise it selects fixtures as `renderSelected` does (`internal/cli/render_test.go:471`): the `general` ones when `-render-fixture` is empty, else the named ones. An unknown name calls `t.Fatalf("no render fixture %q; the fixtures are ...")`. With `-renders DIR` it writes each `.txt` file at mode 0o600. With `-render-print` it prints a header line and the text for each file to stdout.
4. Add the tests named under Failing tests to the same file. The subprocess tests use `os.Args[0]` and `t.TempDir()`, as the CLI test does.
